name: pelagic-ui
description: Pelagic UI — accessible, themeable UI components for React, Vue, Svelte, Astro and React Native

scripts.docs:build: npm run build -w @pelagic-ui/core && npm run build -w @pelagic-ui/illustrations && npm run build -w @pelagic-ui/icons && npm run build -w @pelagic-ui/react && npm run build -w @pelagic-ui/three && npm run build -w @pelagic-ui/docs
scripts.release:check: npm run build -w @pelagic-ui/core && npm run build -w @pelagic-ui/illustrations && npm run build -w @pelagic-ui/icons && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @pelagic-ui/react -w @pelagic-ui/vue -w @pelagic-ui/three -w @pelagic-ui/angular && node scripts/build-umbrella.mjs
